title: Governance profile tenant parameter file, version 1 (TRUST.PROFILE.DEFS)
description: The only parameters a site may set on a built-in profile. tenant_meanings is allowed for every profile; required_meanings only for regulated, where it must include APPROVED and name only built-in codes or codes defined in tenant_meanings. Any other key fails instantiation with profile.param_forbidden; fid-profile enforces the profile-dependent and cross-field rules.
